records.source: Fisherman: I came all the way from Grampleton for this.||Fisherman: I'm not leaving without a bag full of trout!
records.translation: 釣客：我可是專程從格蘭普頓遠道而來。||釣客：沒裝滿一整袋鱒魚，我絕不離開！

records.source: Mariner: I think I'm a little overdressed for this event.
records.translation: 水手：我覺得自己參加這活動穿得有點太正式了。

records.source: Mariner: Of course... some guy shows up wearing the same outfit as me. How embarassing!
records.translation: 水手：果然……偏偏有人穿得跟我一模一樣。真丟臉！

records.source: Fisherman: Excuse me, I'm trying to enjoy the peace and quiet.||Fisherman: ...||Fisherman: ...||Fisherman: ...||Fisherman: Can't you take a hint?||Fisherman: ...||Fisherman: ...||Fisherman: ...||Fisherman: Someone's about to get battered, and it ain't the trout.||Fisherman:...
records.translation: 釣客：不好意思，我正想享受這份清靜。||釣客：……||釣客：……||釣客：……||釣客：你看不懂暗示嗎？||釣客：……||釣客：……||釣客：……||釣客：有人就快被揍得滿身是傷了，而且我說的不是鱒魚。||釣客：……

records.source: Fishing Sisters: We're the famous fishing sisters!||Fishing Sisters: We'll fish as many fish as we wish! Nah Nah Nah!
records.translation: 釣魚姊妹：我們就是大名鼎鼎的釣魚姊妹！||釣魚姊妹：想釣多少魚，就釣多少魚！啦啦啦！

records.source: Angler: Any luck? Most of the bites I'm getting are from the mosquitos...
records.translation: 垂釣者：有收穫嗎？我碰到最多的咬鉤，全都來自蚊子……

records.source: Trout Man: Where I come from, they call me 'Trout Man'.||Trout Man: Yep, I spent five years learning how to think like a trout. Pretty simple, actually: food, food, food, lay eggs, rest, eat more food.||Trout Man: I happen to like food, myself. Not so good at laying eggs, though.
records.translation: 鱒魚人：在我的家鄉，大家都叫我「鱒魚人」。||鱒魚人：沒錯，我花了五年學習像鱒魚一樣思考。其實很簡單：食物、食物、食物、產卵、休息、再吃更多食物。||鱒魚人：我自己也碰巧很愛吃，只是不太會產卵。

records.source: Fisherman: Trying to get away from the crowds? I had the same idea.
records.translation: 釣客：想躲開人群嗎？我也是這麼想的。

records.source: Fishing Pro: I know it's not a competition, but still... whoever gets the most tags will have bragging rights for the rest of the year!||Fishing Pro: I'll be back in winter for SquidFest... Now that's a real challenge!||Fishing Pro: The secret to catching trout is, you gotta give them a presentation that looks so delicious, they can't help but take a bite...
records.translation: 釣魚高手：我知道這不算競賽，但話說回來……拿到最多標籤的人，接下來一整年都有本錢炫耀！||釣魚高手：冬天我還會回來參加魷魚節……那才是真正的挑戰！||釣魚高手：釣鱒魚的祕訣，就是把餌呈現得無比美味，讓牠們忍不住咬上一口……

records.source: Fisherman: Ah, now this is the life. Nothing is more tranquil than a day of trout fishing.
records.translation: 釣客：啊，這才叫生活。沒有什麼比釣一整天鱒魚更寧靜了。

records.source: Fisherman: Squid usually only show up at night. But they threw some special bait in the water that's making them active all day.
records.translation: 釣客：魷魚通常只在夜間出沒，不過他們往水裡撒了特殊魚餌，讓魷魚整天都很活躍。

records.source: Mariner: The cold air makes me feel tough, like a piece of jerky.||Mariner: When the air is too warm I feel like a pudding.
records.translation: 水手：冷空氣讓我感覺硬朗，像塊肉乾。||水手：天氣太暖時，我就覺得自己像顆布丁。

records.source: Mariner: Come here, squiddy squiddy...
records.translation: 水手：過來吧，小魷魚、小魷魚……

records.source: Fisherman: You're a local, huh? Hope you don't mind if I pinch a few of your fine squid...
records.translation: 釣客：你是本地人吧？希望你不介意我順走幾條上好的魷魚……

records.source: Fishing Sisters: We're the famous fishing sisters.||Fishing Sisters: We've been fishing squids since we were kids. Nah nah nah!
records.translation: 釣魚姊妹：我們就是大名鼎鼎的釣魚姊妹。||釣魚姊妹：我們從小就開始釣魷魚。啦啦啦！

records.source: Angler: Brrr... It's cold! Maybe I'm not cut out for winter ocean fishing.||Angler: I'm more of a CarpFest kind of guy...
records.translation: 垂釣者：冷冷冷……太冷了！或許我不適合在冬季海釣。||垂釣者：我更像是適合鯉魚節的那種人……

records.source: Trout Man: Welp, squid are a bit different than trout, but I can catch them all the same.||Trout Man: You better get to fishing if you want a shot at the prize!
records.translation: 鱒魚人：唔，魷魚跟鱒魚是有點不同，但我照樣抓得到。||鱒魚人：想爭取獎品的話，最好趕快開始釣魚！

records.source: Fisherman: My wife sent me off with a thermos of hot coffee. What a gal!
records.translation: 釣客：我老婆出門前塞給我一壺熱咖啡。真是個好女人！

records.source: Fishing Pro: Shhh... I don't want to scare the squid.||Fishing Pro: I came over here to get away from the crowd. Squid can be shy.||Fishing Pro: You can fish here if you want, though. Just try to be quiet.
records.translation: 釣魚高手：噓……我不想嚇跑魷魚。||釣魚高手：我來這裡是為了躲開人群，魷魚有時很膽小。||釣魚高手：不過你想的話也能在這裡釣，只要盡量安靜。

records.source: Fisherman: I'm not too worried about winning the competition. I just want to enjoy the ambience.||Fisherman: Summer's weather is nicer, but there's something special about a rugged winter. And what would life be without contrast?
records.translation: 釣客：我不太在乎能不能贏，只想享受這裡的氣氛。||釣客：夏天天氣更舒服，但嚴酷的冬季也別有風味。人生若沒有對比，又會變成什麼樣呢？

records.source: Fisherman: My fingers are frozen solid, so I'm just going to enjoy a hot cup o' cider over here. Good luck out there!
records.translation: 釣客：我的手指凍僵了，所以就在這裡享用一杯熱蘋果酒。祝你在外面好運！

records.source: Squid Chef: Oh, don't mind me... I'm just here for the bulk squid prices!||Squid Chef: Well, what are you waiting for? Those squid aren't going to catch themselves!
records.translation: 魷魚廚師：喔，別管我……我只是為了魷魚的批發價而來！||魷魚廚師：嗯，還在等什麼？那些魷魚可不會自己跳上鉤！
